question: As per Census of India 2011, in which of the following states was the total population less than 10 lakh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sikkim has a population of 6.11 Lakhs.
 
• The Sikkim census of 2011 says the population of Sikkim is the lowest in all of India.
 
• Prem Singh Tamang, better known as P. S. Golay, is an Indian politician of Sikkim and leader and founder of the Sikkim Krantikari Morcha (SKM)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the populations of Telangana, Tripura, and Goa 

 
 
• **Telangana**: The population was approximately **35,193,978**.
 
• **Tripura**: The population was approximately **3,671,032**.
 
• **Goa**: The population was approximately **1,457,723**.
